name: TontaubeV1.1 (open-weight TTS with voice cloning)
summary: Multilingual text-to-speech model (EN/DE primary; ES, FR, IT, NL, PT) for expressive voice cloning from ~5-60 s of reference audio, long-form audiobook generation and streaming. Adds five style sliders (rate, pauses, intonation, pitch, articulation). 4-bit int4 build is a 1.8 GB download that runs on small GPUs (~4 GiB VRAM) and AVX2 x86-64 CPUs; bf16 weights for vLLM.

access.price: $0; commercial license by email above EUR 200k group revenue
access.notes: Free for research/noncommercial and for commercial use under EUR 200k group revenue, with 'Powered by TontaubeV1' credit. Hosted speech-generation services always need a commercial license. Derivatives keep the same license. Inference code Apache-2.0.

procedure: cd tontaube && uv run --python 3.12 --frozen tontaube serve (downloads the int4 model by default; TTS_BACKEND=vllm for bf16, needs 24 GiB NVIDIA GPU)
POST text (and optional voice_audio_b64 reference) to http://127.0.0.1:8080/predict to get WAV audio

verdict.why: Local voice cloning and audiobook TTS that fits on CPU/small GPU; weights ungated and downloadable. Custom license (free under EUR 200k revenue, no hosted TTS service), young repo with low traction so far.
